# tshapedconsultant — Andrés Lage Freire

> AI Governance Engineering: executable controls, lifecycle gates and verifiable evidence across the AI lifecycle.

Andrés Lage Freire designs and governs DGOM™ and Dédalo™. Based in Madrid · Working remotely across EMEA. The practice helps organisations deploying RAG, agents and other high-consequence AI systems turn regulation, policy and risk controls into runtime assurance.

This site was designed and built by Andrés with AI-assisted coding, treating accessibility, privacy, performance and auditability as first-class constraints.

DGOM™ orchestrates governance frameworks. It does not replace legal advice, formal certification or an organisation’s accountable decision-makers.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://tshapedconsultant.com/): Positioning, DGOM™, services, diagnostic, partners, case studies and contact
- [EU AI Act mapping](https://tshapedconsultant.com/governance/eu-ai-act-mapping): Which obligations apply by role and system, executable controls, and the evidence pack an auditor would inspect
- [Whitepaper (on-site)](https://tshapedconsultant.com/whitepaper): The essay is the earlier long edition and is open. The current English PDF is Unified Edition v5.5, 23 pages. The Spanish unified edition is not published; the Spanish PDF is the 30-page edition of 16 November 2026.
- [Whitepaper (PDF, Unified Edition v5.5)](https://tshapedconsultant.com/Probabilistic-Models-Require-Deterministic-Governance.pdf)
- [Previous English PDF, 16 November 2026](https://tshapedconsultant.com/archive/Probabilistic-Models-Require-Deterministic-Governance-2026-11-16.pdf)
- [Dédalo™ Executive Brief (PDF, 2 pages)](https://tshapedconsultant.com/Dedalo-Executive-Brief.pdf): a separate board summary, not the unified edition.
- [Dual-Key Protocol](https://tshapedconsultant.com/governance/dual-key-protocol): Separate AI recommendations from execution authority. Entry offer is the one-week AI Governance Snapshot, not a certification. Reference architectures are not verified production deployments.
- [Dédalo™](https://tshapedconsultant.com/dedalo): Governance frame for workflow redesign, decision rights and runtime controls. The Anthropic Working with AI study (23 November 2026) is directional interview evidence, not a return estimate and not an endorsement.
- [Beyond task automation](https://tshapedconsultant.com/insights/ai-value-workflow-redesign): Open essay. It separates the study from a governance reading. The report PDF was not quoted for a correlation coefficient.
- [BBVA case study (PDF)](https://tshapedconsultant.com/bbva-platform-ai-strategy-case-study.pdf)
- [Responsible AI framework for resume–job matching (PDF)](https://tshapedconsultant.com/responsible-ai-resume-job-matching.pdf)
- [Hybrid profiles article](https://tshapedconsultant.com/hybrid-profiles)
- [Agentic AI and Montesquieu](https://tshapedconsultant.com/agentic-ai-montesquieu)
- [Full outline](https://tshapedconsultant.com/llms-full.txt)
